items.title: The Magic Chair Test
items.explanation: Mario's grandfather challenged him to a bet that he had no friends, but Mario used an invisible chair as a test. When he sat on the chair, his real friends Guneet, Asma, and Deepa held him up so he wouldn't fall, proving they were true friends.

items.title: True Friends vs. Companions
items.explanation: Mario's grandfather told Mario that many of the people in his school might just be companions or partners rather than real friends. True friends are those who care for you and help you when things go wrong.

items.title: Finding Real Friends
items.explanation: After sitting on the invisible chair, Mario saw his real friends holding him up. He learned that true friends are those who support you during difficult times, unlike people who only take joy in your bad luck.
